about: cursorful.com: pointer parked on the hero, scrolled through the embedded YouTube demo (its own black arrow browsing, clicking, saving to a playlist) and the feature demos with the pointer hidden, back to the top, then Pricing and Editor in the fixed nav bar. Recorded 2026-09-24 as 'Cursorful_demo_now'.
notes: The creator's pointer is a white 18px arrow (light:18). The demo's is a black arrow that fits dark:21-22 as well as the creator's fits light:18 (0.848 against 0.845 here, 0.860 against 0.802 in production), and production calibrated to it: located 271/1074 frames, every press filed at the demo's cursor, Pricing and Editor both refused, no zoom at all. locate.js chooseIdentity exists because of it.

The creator's pointer is NOT drawn from about 2.6s to 23.9s — a tab capture stops drawing an idle pointer — so every pointer on screen in that stretch is somebody else's. Pricing was hovered from 23.2s with no pointer drawn; the hand appears on it at 23.9s.
Pricing: hand at (927,44) from 23.9s, the page starts its jump at 24.3s, so the click is ~24.2s. Editor: hand on it from 30.0s, the page goes blank at 31.3s, so the click is ~31.15s.

The boxes are where the demos' cursors actually went, not the whole players: the creator's hidden pointer sits at (270,392), in the left margin of the YouTube player, and our pointer held there is theirs, not a stranger's.

stranger_budget_s (with the model) and stranger_budget_pixel_s (STUDIO_POINTER_VISION=off) are RATCHETS, not targets, measured on 2026-09-24. Without the model the drawn path follows the demo's pointer while the creator's is hidden (never zoomed on); with it, those stretches are judged somebody else's and our pointer holds where the creator's was. Lower them when they improve; never raise them.
